issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按卡片 md 的"移动 12f"猜成 12f，只渲染出原地静止的开头，横移和分身全被截掉
画面上方压着调试标题 "SMEAR MULTIPLES"，两个槽位是 3px 灰色虚线框
灰卡放在同色系灰底上，卡片 md 自己都写了这种底上 0.09 那档分身会消失
起步段几个分身挤在原地叠在一起，文字叠成乱码，"可数"失效
横移从静止直接起跑，没有预备；卡片阴影固定，起飞与落位没有高度变化
changes: 补 SMEAR_MULTIPLES_DURATION = 90；4 分身各差 2f、opacity 0.45/0.30/0.18/0.09、[25,60] 速度门限、35–38f 合拢、3% 过冲回弹全部保留
按 md 建议改"深底浅卡"：冷调深色柔光底 + 暗角 + 颗粒，最弱一档分身也读得开；分身去阴影，叠影干净
新增分身间距门限：与前一副本相距 <36px 不画（[36,90]px 渐入），起步段不再叠成乱码
虚线框改内凹浅槽 + 32px 列名（In review → Shipped），落位时目标列名与圆点 10f 亮起、计数 5→6
发射前 8f 预备回拉 14px；本体起飞抬高 6px、阴影 elevation 4→28，落位后 8f 贴回，之后真静止 47f
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench took "12f move" from the card and rendered only the static opening; the move and ghosts were cut off
A debug title "SMEAR MULTIPLES" sat on top, and both slots were 3px grey dashed boxes
Grey cards on a same-toned grey background; the card's own notes say the 0.09 ghost disappears on such a ground
At launch several ghosts piled up on the spot and their text overlapped into noise, so they were no longer countable
The move started from a dead stop with no anticipation, and the fixed shadow gave no sense of lift-off or landing
changesEn: Added SMEAR_MULTIPLES_DURATION = 90; four ghosts 2f apart, opacity 0.45/0.30/0.18/0.09, the [25,60] speed gate, 35–38f convergence and 3% overshoot are unchanged
Switched to a dark ground with a light card as the card's notes recommend (cool dark backdrop, vignette, grain), so even the faintest ghost reads; ghosts drop their shadows to stay clean
Added a spacing gate: a ghost closer than 36px to the previous copy is not drawn (fading in over 36–90px), so the launch no longer smears into noise
Dashed boxes became recessed wells with 32px column labels (In review → Shipped); on landing the target label and dot light up over 10f and the count goes 5→6
8f, 14px anticipation pull-back before launch; the card lifts 6px with shadow elevation 4→28, settles back over 8f, then holds still for 47f
